runbooks.diagnosis: PgBouncer is a netns passenger of postgres (network_mode: "service:postgres"). A postgres recreate or DB bounce without a passenger recreate orphans pgbouncer in the dead loopback-only netns — every app that dials pgbouncer:6432 (notes, operaton, paperless, ...) gets connection refused while docker compose itself may look fine.
remediation: docker compose up -d pgbouncer after any postgres recreate / DB bounce
Check docker compose ps shows pgbouncer up
Confirm a consumer (e.g. paperless or operaton) reconnects to pgbouncer:6432

runbooks.diagnosis: Connection exhaustion at the pool: a service is leaking connections, or pool_mode does not match the workload (transaction pooling breaks session-level features like prepared statements / advisory locks).
remediation: Identify the leaking client via pg_stat_activity (client_addr counts) on postgres
Verify PgBouncer pool_mode matches the service's expectations (session vs transaction)
Restart the leaking service before touching pgbouncer
